name: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive
summary: 副驾驶视角的语音驾驶模拟：玩家只能通过麦克风口述指令，教妹妹在危险道路上开车。商店 AI 披露说明玩家可与游戏内 NPC 自由语音对话，妹妹的声音由本地模型实时生成，且不收集、不存储玩家语音；同一页面还列出为生成 AI 内容而连接的第三方服务，全球为 Gemini API 与 ChatGPT，中国大陆为 Qwen 与 Byteplus。

aiAreaNotes.ingame: 游玩中玩家可随时用语音与 NPC 对话，妹妹会实时回应；这是游戏核心机制，不是离线预生成内容。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: The user can freely interact with NPCs in the game world through voice chat. The sister’s voice is generated in real time using a local model. We do not collect or store any user voice data under any circumstances.

disclosureQuote: The user can freely interact with NPCs in the game world through voice chat. The sister’s voice is generated in real time using a local model. We do not collect or store any user voice data under any circumstances.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-10-30 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A voice-driven driving simulator played from the passenger seat: the player can only talk the sister character through dangerous roads. The Steam disclosure states that players can hold free voice conversations with in-game NPCs, that the sister’s voice is generated in real time by a local model, and that no player voice data is collected or stored; the same page lists third-party AI services (Gemini API and ChatGPT globally, Qwen and Byteplus in mainland China) used to generate AI content.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full Steam AI disclosure, the game identity, the English discussion homepage and two related threads in full, plus a separate public-report search that read the Kotaku report and the developer’s AI transparency page. Discussion coverage is limited to the homepage and the search is not exhaustive; findings rely on developer statements and public reporting, not an independent audit.

aiAreaNotes.ingame: Players talk to in-game NPCs through voice chat at any point during play, and the sister answers in real time; this is the core mechanic, not pre-generated offline content.
